sources.title: Swathed in Shadow
markers: | summary = '''Swathed in Shadow''' is a passive feature. It allows the wearer to better resist spells while in shadow.

summary: Gain +1 to Constitution saves. Swathed in Shadow also grants +1 to all saves according to the pinned source.

fields.Base value: 115 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Swathed in Shadow: The tooltip limits the +1 saving throw bonus to attacks while obscured. The pinned source reports that the +1 applies at all times.
